macros.name: newmultienvironment
macros.doc: This macro defines a new environment like \newenvironment does but uses the multienv syntax.

macros.name: providemultienvironment
macros.doc: Like \newmultienvironment but the environment is only defined if it is not already defined. The environment is also not defined if there a macro with the same name exists.

macros.name: renewmultienvironment
macros.doc: Like \newmultienvironment but can be used to redefine existing environments.

envs.name: multienv
envs.doc: This environment takes a comma separated list of key=values where the keys are usually environment names and the values the arguments to this environment.
